thread:
Riley: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need final customer-facing wording and to lock owners for remediation + recurrence checks. Short thread please.
Neha: I'll draft the 72h public summary. Plan: plain-language timeline, user impact, and three concrete next steps with owners.
Owen: I'll handle the statuspage one-liner and the small FAQ blurb about what "redacted" means. Keep it short.
Tara: Legal prefers we publish a redacted technical appendix publicly and make the full RCA available to verified customers under NDA or contract terms.
Ben: Ops suggests we also include a public note about "no evidence of data exposure" if that's confirmed. Keeps customer trust.
Riley: Yes include that if verified. Tara, can Legal sign off on a small consent line customers can use to request the full RCA?
Tara: Suggested blurb: "A full technical report is available to affected customers under existing confidentiality terms; contact Support to request." Legal OKs that.
Neha: Draft statuspage snippet + 72h line I plan to use:
```
Status: Partial service disruption for inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: Some requests experienced elevated latency and increased errors between 02:05-02:50 UTC.
Current status: Service performance restored for the majority of customers; a redacted technical summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Owen: Tiny edit: change "majority" -> "most" and add a CTA link to support for RCA requests.
Neha: Updated.
Riley: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Neha: Draft 72h redacted summary (due T+36h).
- Owen: Statuspage one-liner + FAQ blurb (due T+8h).
- Tara(Legal): Redaction checklist & review (within 24h of draft).
- Ben(Ops): Run 90-day recurrence query; file PRD-5401 (due T+7d).
- SupportLead: Prepare outreach list and NDA flow for requests (due T+48h).
Owen: FAQ blurb draft: "Redacted = internal identifiers and sensitive logs removed; timeline and root cause summary preserved."
Tara: Legal approves that FAQ copy.
Ben: For recurrence check I'll attach the PromQL snippet to PRD-5401: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and link dashboards.
SupportLead: We'll prepare templates and a simple eligibility checklist for who can request the full RCA.
Riley: Let's also add a short "what we're fixing" list in the public 72h summary (3 bullets) with owners and estimated quarters. Keeps customers confident.
Neha: Adding owners + Q estimates now.
Owen: I'll save the status template to /templates/status/one-line.md so teams reuse the same language.
OpsBot: @Ben Recurrence job PRD-5401 created and scheduled.
Tara: Once Neha publishes the draft, tag Legal and Support for sign-off. Legal will prioritize.
Neha: Draft posted to the postmortem doc and tagged Legal + Support.
SupportLead: We'll hold outreach until Legal confirms redactions, then send enterprise notices.
Riley: Great. We'll add a T+7 owners reminder in #incident-owners and close the loop once PRD-5401 results are in. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
